The figure presents a bar chart comparing the percentages of three metals - Aluminium, Copper, and Nickel - for two regions, Deutschland and EU, across three years: 2021, 2022, and 2023.

The chart type is a grouped bar chart. The horizontal axis lists the metals, while the vertical axis represents the percentage values, ranging from 0 to 30%, with tick labels at intervals of 5%. 

For Deutschland, the Aluminium bars are blue, with values of 3.6% in 2021, 2.7% in 2022, and 1.0% in 2023. The Copper bars are purple, with values of 8.3% in 2021, 11.3% in 2022, and 2.2% in 2023. The Nickel bars are grey, with values of 25.1% in 2021, 24.7% in 2022, and 11.4% in 2023.

For EU, the Aluminium bars are blue, with values of 3.2% in 2021, 2.8% in 2022, and 1.7% in 2023. The Copper bars are purple, with values of 4.4% in 2021, 5.1% in 2022, and 1.3% in 2023. The Nickel bars are grey, with values of 24.3% in 2021, 23.3% in 2022, and 14.6% in 2023.

The bars are sorted in descending order of their values within each region and year, and no specific highlighting is applied to any bars.

DESCRIPTION: The figure presents a grouped bar chart comparing the percentages of Aluminium, Copper, and Nickel for Deutschland and EU across 2021, 2022, and 2023. The horizontal axis lists the metals, while the vertical axis represents the percentage values, ranging from 0 to 30%. For Deutschland, Aluminium ranges from 1.0% to 3.6%, Copper from 2.2% to 11.3%, and Nickel from 11.4% to 25.1%. For EU, Aluminium ranges from 1.7% to 3.2%, Copper from 1.3% to 5.1%, and Nickel from 14.6% to 24.3%. The bars are color-coded by metal: blue for Aluminium, purple for Copper, and grey for Nickel.
